# The Skitter-Kin & Rad-Scavengers — Draft Datasheets

*Owned verb: **SCURRY** · generated by `unit_calculator.py faction` · ×1.5 scale · stat line = MOV · MS · RS · ARM · MIGHT · CTRL*

**Core trait — Scurry · Seething Swarm:** Scurry: once per round, after an enemy unit finishes an activation, one unengaged Skitter-Kin unit may make a free 3″ move (not toward the enemy that just activated). Skitter-Kin units may Fall Back without being Rattled. Seething Swarm: once per round, at the End of Round, one Class 1 [FRAIL] unit returns D3 slain models (never above Starting Strength).

**Gamble — More-More Rad-Power!** *(risk: durability (dice))*: When a unit with an [OVERLOAD] weapon is selected to Shoot, you may Overcharge: roll a D6 — 1 KABOOM: the unit suffers D3 Fatal Wounds and does not Shoot · 2–5: +1 to Wound and +1 Damage · 6: also +1 PEN and +2 Attacks.

**Army-wide rules (priced into every unit):** *Scurry* — 3″ react-move once per round. · *Too Quick* — Fall Back without Rattled.

## Detachment — Rad-Tech Clans

*Weapon-teams and engines overcharging every activation.*

**Detachment rule:** Tinker-Tinker: Overcharge rolls of 1 may be re-rolled once per round (army-wide); Weapon Teams within 3″ of a Class 1 unit are [UNSEEN 12″].

**Enhancements**
- **Rad-Stone Amulet** (+10 pts, Under-Chief Warlock-Engineer): Units within 6″ ignore Overcharge KABOOM on a 4+.
- **Overclocked Barrels** (+10 pts, Rotary Scrap-Gun Team): +1 Attack.

**Stratagems**
- **Rad-Surge** (1 CP) — *A unit Overcharges:* Roll two dice and pick one.
- **Duck Behind the Slaves** (1 CP) — *A Weapon Team is targeted within 3″ of a Class 1 unit:* The Class 1 unit takes the attack instead.
- **Burn-Out** (1 CP) — *A unit suffers KABOOM:* Each enemy unit within 3″ also suffers D3 Fatal Wounds.

## Detachment — Burrowing Swarm

*Hordes appearing from table edges and drills (no portals).*

**Detachment rule:** Underhive Ambush: up to 3 Class 1 units may start in Reserves and arrive from Round 2 wholly within 6″ of any table edge or within 3″ of a friendly Subterranean Rad-Drill, more than 8″ from enemies.

**Enhancements**
- **Tunnel-Map** (+10 pts, Gutter-Assassin): One unit arriving from Reserves may arrive 6″ from enemies instead of 8″.
- **Swarm-Master's Whip** (+15 pts, Clan-Lord Clawmaster): Friendly Class 1 units within 6″ get +1 to Hit in melee.

**Stratagems**
- **Endless Tide** (2 CP) — *Command Phase, once per battle:* Return a destroyed Class 1 [FRAIL] unit at half strength from a table edge.
- **Scurry Away** (1 CP) — *An enemy unit finishes an activation:* Scurry a second unit this round.
- **Overwhelm** (1 CP) — *A unit with 10+ models declares a Charge:* +2″ to the Charge roll.

## Detachment — Skilled Manipulators

*Leaders hide behind the horde while it soaks the damage.*

**Detachment rule:** Expendable Kin: Leaders within 3″ of a friendly Class 1 unit have WARD 4+ against ranged attacks; any saved damage is inflicted on that Class 1 unit instead (1 Fatal Wound per save).

**Enhancements**
- **Cowardly Cunning** (+10 pts, Under-Chief Warlock-Engineer): [STEALTH].
- **Crown of the Gutter-King** (+15 pts, Clan-Lord Clawmaster): The attached unit has UNYIELDING 6+.

**Stratagems**
- **Sacrifice the Slaves** (1 CP) — *A Leader is targeted in melee within 3″ of a Class 1 unit:* Remove D3 models from that unit: the Leader is −1 to be Hit.
- **Fleeing Fury** (1 CP) — *A unit Falls Back:* It may Shoot this activation.
- **Kin-Shield** (1 CP) — *A Class 2–3 unit is targeted within 3″ of a Class 1 unit:* It is [STEALTH] for the attack.
